stories.title: Morning intelligence brief — scheduled WhatsApp at 8:45 CT
stories.goal: Every weekday at 8:45 AM CT, JARVIS sends a pre-market WhatsApp brief covering: MCL and MNQ current price and STC value, market regime, any open paper positions with unrealized P&L, daily P&L context, and number of signals today. This gives Matt a 60-second situational awareness read before the open.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/notifications/morning_brief.py: new file with assemble_morning_brief(data_manager, paper_tracker, safety_layer) -> str async function. Returns a formatted multi-line string. Never raises — returns a fallback string on any error.
assemble_morning_brief() calls data_manager.get_current_price('MCL') and data_manager.get_current_price('MNQ') concurrently via asyncio.gather. On price fetch failure, uses 'N/A' as fallback.

assemble_morning_brief() calls data_manager.get_bars(symbol, lookback_days=3, timeframe='1h') then runs generate_signals(df, symbol=symbol) from backtest.signals to get df.iloc[-1]['stc_val'] and df.iloc[-1]['regime']. On failure, uses 'STC: N/A' and 'UNKNOWN'.

assemble_morning_brief() calls paper_tracker.get_open_positions() to list open trades. For each position, computes unrealized P&L using INSTRUMENT_POINT_VALUES dict (MCL=100.0, MNQ=2.0, MES=5.0, default=1.0) and direction from action field (buy/long = +, sell/short = -).
assemble_morning_brief() calls safety_layer.get_status() to get daily_pnl and kill_switch_active.

Message format (exact): first line 'JARVIS Pre-Market Brief — MM/DD HH:MM CT', then blank line, then 'MCL: $XX.XX (STC: XX | REGIME)' and 'MNQ: $XX (STC: XX | REGIME)', then blank line, then 'Positions: N open' with each position on its own line as '  SYMBOL DIRECTION xQTY @ $ENTRY → $UNR_PNL', then blank line, then 'Daily P&L: $X.XX | Kill switch: INACTIVE/ACTIVE'. Total message under 400 characters.

stories.title: Unrealized P&L API — GET /portfolio/paper/positions/unrealized
stories.goal: Add an endpoint that returns all open paper positions enriched with current market price and calculated unrealized P&L. The dashboard widget polls this every 10 seconds. The endpoint must be fast — use the price cache when available, fall back gracefully when price is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/routers/portfolio_router.py: add GET /portfolio/paper/positions/unrealized endpoint

Endpoint returns list of UnrealizedPositionResponse objects. Schema: trade_id (str), symbol (str), action (str), quantity (float), entry_price (float), current_price (float | None), unrealized_pnl (float | None), unrealized_pnl_pct (float | None), stop_loss (float | None), take_profit (float | None), stop_distance (float | None), target_distance (float | None), entry_time (str), direction (str — 'LONG' or 'SHORT')

For each open position from paper_tracker.get_open_positions(), fetch current_price via data_manager.get_current_price(symbol). Use asyncio.gather() to fetch all prices concurrently. On price fetch failure, current_price=None, unrealized_pnl=None.
INSTRUMENT_POINT_VALUES defined in portfolio_router.py: {'MCL': 100.0, 'MNQ': 2.0, 'MES': 5.0, 'MGC': 10.0, 'DEFAULT': 1.0}. Look up symbol.upper(), fall back to 'DEFAULT'.
direction computed from action field: 'buy'/'buy_to_open'/'long' → 'LONG'. 'sell'/'sell_to_open'/'short' → 'SHORT'. Default 'LONG' for unknown.
unrealized_pnl = (current_price - entry_price) * point_value * quantity for LONG. (entry_price - current_price) * point_value * quantity for SHORT. None if current_price is None.
unrealized_pnl_pct = (unrealized_pnl / (entry_price * point_value * quantity)) * 100 if computable, else None.
stop_distance = abs(current_price - stop_loss) if both are not None, else None. target_distance = abs(take_profit - current_price) if both are not None, else None.
Response Pydantic model: class UnrealizedPositionResponse(BaseModel): — use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). Wrap the whole endpoint in try/except with HTTPException(500).

engine/tests/test_unrealized_pnl.py: new test file. Tests: (1) GET /portfolio/paper/positions/unrealized returns 200 with empty list when no positions. (2) Unrealized P&L calculation for LONG MCL with current=73, entry=72, qty=1 returns unrealized_pnl=100.0. (3) Unrealized P&L calculation for SHORT MNQ with current=17480, entry=17500, qty=1 returns unrealized_pnl=40.0. (4) Returns None unrealized_pnl when data_manager not injected. (5) stop_distance computed correctly.
